import numpy as np import matplotlib as mpl import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
BLUE = "#33658A" TEAL = "#2A9D8F" SLATE = "#657786" INK = "#263238"
mpl.rcParams.update({ "font.family": "DejaVu Sans", "mathtext.fontset": "dejavusans", "font.size": 10, "text.color": INK, "axes.labelcolor": INK, "axes.edgecolor": SLATE, "xtick.color": SLATE, "ytick.color": SLATE, "figure.facecolor": "white", "axes.facecolor": "white", "svg.fonttype": "none", "lines.linewidth": 2.0, })
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(10, 4), dpi=100)
n = np.arange(4) t = np.linspace(0, 4, 601) samples_original = np.array([1., 0., -1., 0.]) samples_shifted = np.array([0., 1., 0., -1.])
# The coefficient convention is projection onto the unnormalized # discrete basis vectors c_1[n] and s_1[n]. c1 = np.cos(2 * np.pi * n / 4) s1 = np.sin(2 * np.pi * n / 4) for values, expected in [ (samples_original, (1., 0.)), (samples_shifted, (0., 1.)), ]: coefficients = ( np.dot(values, c1) / np.dot(c1, c1), np.dot(values, s1) / np.dot(s1, s1), ) if not np.allclose(coefficients, expected): raise ValueError("Samples do not match the stated discrete projections.")
panels = [ { "left": 0.075, "center": 0.2925, "title": "Original wave", "formula": r"$x(t)=\cos(2\pi t/4)$", "curve": np.cos(2 * np.pi * t / 4), "samples": samples_original, "color": BLUE, "vector": r"$\mathbf{x}=[1,\ 0,\ -1,\ 0]^{\mathsf{T}}$", "coefficients": r"$a_1=1\quad\longrightarrow\quad b_1=0$", }, { "left": 0.565, "center": 0.7825, "title": r"Shifted by 1 sample · $\phi=\pi/2$", "formula": r"$x_{\mathrm{shifted}}(t)=\cos[2\pi(t-1)/4]=\sin(2\pi t/4)$", "curve": np.cos(2 * np.pi * (t - 1) / 4), "samples": samples_shifted, "color": TEAL, "vector": r"$\mathbf{x}_{\mathrm{shifted}}=[0,\ 1,\ 0,\ -1]^{\mathsf{T}}$", "coefficients": r"$a_1=0\quad\longrightarrow\quad b_1=1$", }, ]
for p in panels: fig.text(p["center"], 0.953, p["title"], ha="center", va="center", fontsize=13, fontweight="semibold", color=p["color"]) fig.text(p["center"], 0.875, p["formula"], ha="center", va="center", fontsize=11)
ax = fig.add_axes([p["left"], 0.435, 0.405, 0.345]) ax.axhline(0, color=SLATE, alpha=0.32, linewidth=0.8, zorder=0) ax.vlines(n, 0, p["samples"], color=p["color"], alpha=0.27, linewidth=1.3, zorder=1) ax.plot(t, p["curve"], color=p["color"], label="Continuous wave", zorder=2) ax.scatter(n, p["samples"], s=34, color=p["color"], edgecolor="white", linewidth=0.8, label="Samples", zorder=3) ax.set_xlim(-0.12, 4.08) ax.set_ylim(-1.22, 1.25) ax.set_xticks(np.arange(5)) ax.set_yticks([-1, 0, 1]) ax.set_xlabel(r"$t$ (samples)", fontsize=9, labelpad=3) ax.set_ylabel("Amplitude (dimensionless)", fontsize=9, labelpad=7) ax.tick_params(labelsize=9, length=3, width=0.8) for side in ("top", "right"): ax.spines[side].set_visible(False) for side in ("left", "bottom"): ax.spines[side].set_linewidth(0.8) ax.legend(loc="upper right", frameon=False, fontsize=7.6, handlelength=1.8, labelspacing=0.3, borderaxespad=0.3)
fig.text(p["center"], 0.292, p["vector"], ha="center", va="center", fontsize=12) coefficients = (r"Cosine: $a_1=1$ Sine: $b_1=0$" if p["color"] == BLUE else r"Cosine: $a_1=0$ Sine: $b_1=1$") fig.text(p["center"], 0.221, coefficients, ha="center", va="center", fontsize=11.5, color=p["color"], fontweight="medium")
fig.text( 0.5, 0.119, "Same frequency: 1 cycle per 4 samples. Energy transfers completely from cosine to sine.", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=11, color=INK, ) fig.text( 0.5, 0.051, r"Amplitude is unchanged: $\sqrt{a_1^2+b_1^2}=1$ in both cases.", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=11, color=SLATE, )
